name: COGAGING
title: COGAGING
description: Cognitive ageing cohort: clinical MRI from CDs (multi-vendor), with 3D T1w + 3D FLAIR, 64-direction DWI and resting-state BOLD.
sessions_note: Exams of the same subject are numbered ses-1, ses-2, ... by exam date. The date -> number map stays in sourcedata/session_map.tsv (outside bids/). A new exam OLDER than one already numbered stops the run for a human decision.
recon_note: Same recon-all as the Cog-Aging guide (section 3.2: -all -qcache -3T, T1 only), so subjects run before this pipeline stay comparable.
steps_note: No defacing until the study decides whether data will be shared externally.
